QUOTE: "Approved if `auto_approve_tools` is set, or the call matches the allow list (`ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` → `PermissionManager::is_allowed`)." and "Execute (`src/mcp/server_manager.cpp:153`). `is_denied()` is checked on the deny list... This runs even when approval passed via `auto_approve` or the allow list."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the allow list only affects approval and never overrides deny. It never says the list is consulted only from `check_approval`, and it names `is_explicitly_allowed` in `ServerManager` as a separate location, so the item's specific mechanism isn't stated.
